collection.title: Vauxhall Cascada 2012 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Cascada 2012 Onwards requires a 27" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 25" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: Vauxhall Cascada 2012 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
